req.title: Login required for delete
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they POST /<id>/delete.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that anonymous users should be redirected to the login page when attempting to delete a post. This behavior ensures that only authenticated users can perform delete operations, maintaining security and data integrity. The test suite will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive validation of this requirement.

tests.name: test_delete_redirects_anonymous_user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

tests.name: test_delete_post_authenticated_user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db, get_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute("INSERT INTO user (id, username, password) VALUES (1, 'test', 'test')")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO post (id, title, body, author_id) VALUES (1, 'title', 'body', 1)")
    db.commit()

client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
